assertions.assertion: The denial being appealed carries reason code CO-197.
The service at issue is CPT 93229.
CPT 93229 corresponds to Mobile Cardiac Telemetry monitoring.
The payer states the claim was denied because precertification or prior authorization was not obtained before services were rendered.
The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a sensation of irregular heartbeat.
These symptoms are concerning for potential arrhythmias.
The patient has known nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency.
The submitted diagnosis codes are I34.0 and R00.2.
Mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture continuous rhythm data during daily activities to correlate symptoms with any underlying cardiac conduction abnormalities.
There exists an indication note document referenced as the source of the ordering rationale.
The appellant requests review of the missing authorization and payment of the outstanding balance.
